about: The allowlist scripts/publish_tree.py copies into a new folder that becomes the public repository's first commit (a fresh history). A file is published only when it matches an include pattern and no exclude pattern; a published file that matches a never pattern refuses the whole tree. Patterns are relative to the checkout: ** spans folders, * and ? stay inside one name. Decisions: Apache-2.0 (the licence), D10 (the personal model repository link is not published), D11 (product docs only: phase records, the handoff files and account-folder names stay private), D12 (Copyright 2026 Tohin Majumder).
